besluite.fout: The glossary entry for eiland says 'met water rondom' while the study text says 'met water reg rondom', so the learner meets two phrasings of one definition in the same lesson; the glossary wording itself is correct Afrikaans.
besluite.rede: A glossary definition may only be reworded through the writer, who should decide whether to align the two phrasings (and in which direction) across every lesson that defines eiland.
